App also includes a 3D spatializer option which is supposed to create a unique experience when listening to music.  For the equalizer, we have preloaded 15+ presets (Normal, Classic, Dance, Flat, Acoustic,  Electronic, Heavy Metal, Hip Hop, Jazz, Pop, Rock etc.). In addition, you can create your own custom presets (premium feature). This app also has built in audio visualizations, designed to boost your audio visual & listening experience. 

Features Summary:
- 10 band Equalizer
- Bass Booster
- 3D Audio Spatializer & Positioning
- Audio Visualizations
- 15+ Equalizer Presets
- Custom EQ Preset Design
- Intuitive Player Controls - Shuffle, Repeat etc.
- Create & Manage Playlists
- Sleep Timer
- Import from Dropbox, OneDrive, Files & WiFi
- Audio Effects - Reverb, Echo, Chorus etc.
